textes.le film « Vibe Connection » décrit dans: the film “Vibe Connection” described in scenario.md (in this folder): read it in full before anything else. It is a mock silent, retro film of 1 min 40 promoting pulse-motion, in 7 freely composed scenes, one per sequence, with exactly the durations in the script (20, 6, 17, 8, 23, 10 and 16 seconds) and these scene names: generique, installation, probleme, tournant, demo, preuve, pancartes. Storytelling genre, square 1:1 format at 25 frames per second, tech-sombre style, dark tone, no voice and no subtitles, inspiring ambient composed music (soft pads and melody, no chiptune sounds) at 120 beats per minute, volume 0.45. The on-screen texts are the script's title cards, word for word; no text smaller than 38 px. For this first draft: the sets, title cards, camera and objects of each sequence, with the plugin's Tousfous (the “touffu” drawing, height 14% of the frame in a wide shot) and only the poses and moves from the library; the film's own gestures, the particle effects and the sound effects will come later.
